name: PT NexAI Digital Infrastruktur Tbk
summary: PT Panca Anugrah Wisesa Tbk, established in 1990 and headquartered in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia, primarily engages in the wholesale supply of a diverse range of household goods and equipment. The company's product portfolio includes furniture for living rooms, bathrooms, kitchens, and wardrobes, alongside various bathroom and wardrobe accessories, kitchen and sanitary appliances, and upscale interior fittings.
